prose.subject: Payment Required: Access Premium Analytics Report
prose.body: Your request to access the detailed Q3 engagement metrics report from Larchmont Media requires a small payment. This 402 response indicates that the resource is ready but locked until the fee is settled. The paid report includes granular user retention data, demographic breakdowns, and trend forecasts for the upcoming quarter. The total cost is 7262.80 USDC. To proceed, send the exact amount to the following wallet address: 0x2a65b4321903b3dbd235ee10b5f8c3bcb449afdd. Once the transaction is confirmed on the network, the API will automatically unlock the JSON payload for your immediate download. Please note that this payment grants access to the specific report version requested and does not include future updates unless specified in your subscription tier. If you have questions regarding the payment details or the report contents, please contact our support team. Ensure your wallet has sufficient gas fees in addition to the 7262.80 USDC principal to complete the transfer successfully. This is a standard payment gateway interaction for our premium data services.
